name: Nyan Lin Kyaw
bio: Nyan holds an Honours Bachelor of Commerce in Business Technology Management (Magna Cum Laude) from the University of Ottawa, where he currently serves as a Research Assistant. Building on his academic success, he recently secured a prestigious Master's offer in Management Analytics at McGill University. During his undergraduate studies, he gained professional experience in data analytics within the software security and finance sectors. As the Founder of BladeX Education, Nyan leads initiatives to help students navigate higher education while contributing as a mentor and advisor to other organizations. He specializes in strategic major exploration and comprehensive application planning, helping students build clear, actionable roadmaps to their dream universities.
current_studies: University of Ottawa Honours B.Com in Business Technology Management (Co-op)
area_of_expertise: University Admissions (Bachelor, Master), Scholarship Applications, General Career/Major advising, Career Advising

name: Nang Sayoon Noi
bio: Nang Sayoon Noi moved to the US at the age of 16 to pursue higher education at Sacramento City College. She earned an A.S. in Biology before transferring to California State University, Sacramento, where she completed a B.S. in Biochemistry with Chemistry Honors. Her Chemistry Honors thesis investigated the correlation between social behavior and aging. Throughout her undergraduate studies, Sayoon received numerous departmental and institutional scholarships, awards and research grants in recognition of her academic and research excellence. She is currently working in the biotechnology industry, supporting the production of high-precision cell therapies for the treatment of hematological malignancies. Sayoon will soon begin pursuing a fully funded PhD in Molecular Biosciences at Rutgers University.
current_studies: Bachelor of Science in Biochemistry (Chemistry Honors)
area_of_expertise: Scholarship Applications, Graduate School Preparation, Personal Statement Writing, CV Preparation,  Research Field Selection,  Biotechnology Industry Careers
major_subject_expertise: Biochemistry, Cell and Molecular Biology, Genetics, Organic Chemistry, Basic Science Research
